content:
Was intended to be a replacement for build.zig build script.

When I ported build.zig to basic-cli for godot-roc, the main thing that was missing was concurrency / parallel tasks & caching for some parts of my CI pipeline.

This is an attempt at parallel tasks.

https://github.com/scottc/roc-build

"0.0.1-pre-alpha-test1"

app [main!] {
    pf: platform "https://github.com/scottc/roc-build/releases/download/0.0.1-pre-alpha-test1/8jZuyEFpCc7ep6yu2iXBT4cAYoxZdjTk5kxShUCMXqgx.tar.zst",
    roc: "nightly-2026-09-27-a3ce7f1",
}

A trivial example:

app [main!] {
    pf: platform "https://github.com/scottc/roc-build/releases/download/0.0.1-pre-alpha-test1/8jZuyEFpCc7ep6yu2iXBT4cAYoxZdjTk5kxShUCMXqgx.tar.zst",
    roc: "nightly-2026-09-27-a3ce7f1",
}

import pf.Build
import pf.Log

main! : List(Str) => Try({}, [Exit(I32)])
main! = |_args| {
    Log.info!("Hello World.")

    pwd_id = 0
    pwd = Build.cmd({
        id: pwd_id,
        depends_on: [],
        inputs: [],
        outputs: [],
        program: "pwd",
        args: [],
        description: "Print working directory",
        cwd: "",
        env: [],
    })

    graph = Build.graph([
        pwd,
    ])

    match Build.run!(graph) {
        Ok({}) => {
            Log.info!("all tasks finished")
            Ok({})
        }
        Err(BuildFailed(msg)) => {
            Log.error!(msg)
            Err(Exit(1))
        }
    }
}

roc run examples/pwd.roc

https://github.com/scottc/roc-build/tree/master/examples

And yes, it builds itself!

It currently has a wave scheduler... I'll want to replace it with eager scheduler.

And add optional hashing & caching support, per task for tasks that don't implement their caching mechanisms etc.

Github actions intergration.

More targets etc.

And the api isn't finalised, I can't imagine too many breaking changes that'll cause too many headaches. It should be flexible enough for many/most configurations.
